metadata.name: Secrets Reveal
metadata.description:
Reveals what the floor is hiding, without touching anything else.
[h1]On the map[/h1] As soon as you arrive on a floor, these are drawn on the minimap with their icons: [list] [*]Secret Room [*]Super Secret Room [*]Ultra Secret Room [*]Any room whose layout contains a Crawlspace [/list] Same idea as the Blue Map: it shows you [i]which wall[/i] to bomb, not the door itself.
[h1]In the room[/h1] A pulsing reticle is drawn over: [list] [*][b]Violet hollow arrow[/b] - the rock this room's crawlspace is buried under [*][b]Violet solid arrow[/b] - a crawlspace, already open [*][b]Cyan diamond[/b] - Tinted Rock [*][b]Gold star[/b] - Super Tinted Rock [*][b]Green hollow arrow[/b] - skull carrying an X mark, which drops a reward when broken [/list]
The hollow violet marker is the one worth having. It names the exact rock a crawlspace is buried under before you break anything, then turns solid once the crawlspace is open. This is not guesswork: the engine picks that grid index when the room loads and exposes it directly, so the mod simply asks. If the chosen spot holds no breakable rock, the crawlspace is unreachable there and nothing is drawn.
Markers vanish the moment a rock breaks, and crawlspaces uncovered mid-room (broken rocks, bombed floors) are picked up automatically.
[h1]Controls[/h1] [list] [*][b]F5[/b] - toggle the whole mod [*][b]F6[/b] - show/hide the bottom-left notices [/list] Both keys are rebindable through Mod Config Menu, which also exposes per-room-type and per-marker toggles, marker size and text size. Mod Config Menu is optional - without it the defaults apply and both keys work.
[h1]Notes[/h1] [list] [*]Lua only, no content overrides. It does [b]not[/b] disable achievements. [*]Turning the mod off does not un-reveal rooms already on the map - the game has no API for hiding a room again. It stops revealing new ones. [*]The buried crawlspace is identified as you walk into the room, so it cannot be flagged on the map ahead of time. [/list]
[hr][/hr] Source, issues and changelog: https://github.com/ghoulfik/tboi-secrets-reveal
